## Activity

During January 2021, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 254 captures. This represents the site’s reported activity for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. The activity figure is reported as captures rather than as a separate count of patient encounters.

## Image quality

Of the 254 captures, 10 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.9 per cent. This measure identifies the proportion of images that could not be used for grading and is reported alongside the underlying count for clarity. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

There were 48 referable results during January 2021. The median grading lag was 1 day. This is the midpoint of the reported wait for grading and is presented with the referable result count to summarise the month’s grading performance. Together, these figures provide a concise view of activity, image usability and grading outcomes at Harbour Eye Clinic for the reporting period.
